description.p: Couchside turns a Plasma Bigscreen TV into a Music Assistant speaker and remote. It plays music on the TV through a bundled Sendspin client, shows what is playing with synced lyrics, and is fully usable with a TV remote.

New look: a top bar with tabs, a centred Now Playing with Up Next, a full-screen Lyrics tab and a Visualizer tab (Radial Pulse, Flow Lines, Bars, Party). Pick the audio output and what the visualizer listens to from a list; choose the colours.
Phase 1: connect to Music Assistant, bundled Sendspin player, basic playback controls.
